_howto: 1) .venv\Scripts\python -m sidecar.midi_tap watch --port X1   2) move a control; the [port] prefix tells WHICH unit sent it (you own TWO X1 MK3s -> two ports)   3) add {"port": "X1 MK3 2", "channel": 0, "kind": "cc", "number": 21, "label": "FX1 · Dry/Wet", "deck": "FX", "widget": "fx1_drywet"}. 'port' is an optional substring: include it to scope an entry to ONE unit (recommended for identical controllers), omit it to match any unit. widget must match an id in layout.json (else HUD-only). Optional "page": "fx" scopes by X1 page; register switches in page_buttons.
_ports_note: This machine shows: 'TRAKTOR X1 MK3 2' (unit 1) and '2 - TRAKTOR X1 MK3 3' (unit 2). Identify which physical unit is which by wiggling one knob while watch runs.
